paragraphs.text: # dsh-usd-brep
English | 中文
DSH 宿主插件：让 DSH agent 通过宿主工具驱动 NVIDIA Omniverse 的 `usd-brep` Python 库（基于 NURBS 的 BRep 实体建模 + 原生 OpenU
：让 DSH agent 通过宿主工具驱动 NVIDIA Omniverse 的 `usd-brep` Python 库（基于 NURBS 的 BRep 实体建模 + 原生 OpenUSD I/O）。
插件在本地创建并管理一个隔离的 CPython 3.12 venv（usd-brep 的 wheel 只发 3.12，64 位 Windows/Linux x86_64/aarch64），首次使用时自
动 `pip install usd-brep`，之后 agent 可以调用三个宿主工具来探测环境、跑内置示例、执行自定义 snippet。
## 中文
### 工具
| 工具名 | 参数 | 说明 |

| `usd_brep_version` | （无） | 探测 venv 能否 `import usd_brep`，返回版本号 + 可用子模块列表。 |
| `usd_brep_run_example

` | `usda`（可选） | 内置示例：球 − 盒布尔差，导出 `.usda` 并重新导入做 sanity check。 |
| `usd_brep_run_snippet` | `code`（必
需）、`usda`（可选） | 执行 agent 写的 Python snippet。约定：snippet 必须 `print(json.dumps(...))` 输出最终 JSON 值，宿主解析后作
为 `result` 返回；导出时把 `.usda` 路径传 `usda`（注入到环境变量 `USD_BREP_OUT`）。 |

方式一：从本仓库安装（dsh-market 或插件管理器）：

| `pythonExe` | `""` | 显式指定 CPython 3.12 解释器；留空则自动探测（uv 托管位置 → `py -3.12`）。 |
| `venvDir` | `""`（= `

~/.dsh-usd-brep-venv`） | venv 目录；留空用每用户默认位置（与宿主 cwd 无关）；相对路径按 `process.cwd()` 解析。 |
| `autoInstall`

| `true` | 缺失时自动 `pip install usd-brep`。 |
| `workDir` | `""` | 运行 snippet/示例时的 cwd。 |
| `timeoutMs`

| `120000` | snippet 执行超时（毫秒）。 |
| `defaultUsda` | `brep_example.usda` | `usd_brep_run_example` 默认输

000` | snippet 执行超时（毫秒）。 |
| `defaultUsda` | `brep_example.usda` | `usd_brep_run_example` 默认输出文件名。 |
### 平台要求

- CPython 3.12（wheel 仅 3.12；Windows 需 MSVC Redistributable）。
- 不要在同一环境混装 `usd-core` 25.11（同版本符号冲突会崩溃

）。
- usd-brep 轮子内置 OpenUSD runtime 25.11，模型在库间通过文件交换（不共享 `pxr` 内存对象）。
## English
A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) host plugin that lets DSH agents drive the NVIDIA Omniverse `usd-brep` Pyth
on library (NURBS-based BRep solid modeling with native OpenUSD I/O) through host tools.
The plugin creates and manages an isolated CPython 3.12 venv locally (usd-brep wheels are published
for 3.12 only, 64-bit Windows/Linux x86_64/aarch64), runs `pip install usd-brep` automatically on fi
rst use, and then registers three host tools for the agent to probe the environment, run the built-i
n example, or execute custom snippets.
### Tools
| Tool | Parameters | Description |
| `usd_brep_version` | (none) | Probes whether the venv can `import usd_brep`; returns the version +

available submodules. |
| `usd_brep_run_example` | `usda` (optional) | Built-in example: sphere − b

ox boolean difference, export `.usda` and re-import as a sanity check. |
| `usd_brep_run_snippet` |
`code` (required), `usda` (optional) | Runs an agent-supplied Python snippet. Contract: the snippet
must `print(json.dumps(...))` a final JSON value, which the host parses and returns as `result`; pas
s the `.usda` path via `usda` when exporting (injected as env var `USD_BREP_OUT`). |
### Install
From this repository (via dsh-market or the plugin manager):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Or from a local directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The host runs `apply(ctx, rawConfig)` on load, registering all three tools.
### Configuration
| Key | Default | Description |
| `pythonExe` | `""` | Explicit CPython 3.12 interpreter; empty = auto-detect (uv-managed location →

`py -3.12`). |
| `venvDir` | `""` (= `~/.dsh-usd-brep-venv`) | venv directory; empty = per-user def

ault (cwd-independent); relative paths resolve against `process.cwd()`. |
| `autoInstall` | `true` |

Auto `pip install usd-brep` when missing. |
| `workDir` | `""` | cwd for snippet/example runs. |
|

`timeoutMs` | `120000` | Snippet execution timeout (ms). |
| `defaultUsda` | `brep_example.usda` | D
efault output file name for `usd_brep_run_example`. |
### Platform notes

- CPython 3.12 (wheels are 3.12-only; Windows needs the MSVC Redistributable).
- Do not install `usd

-core` 25.11 into the same environment (symbol conflicts crash).
- The usd-brep wheel bundles the Op
enUSD 25.11 runtime; models are exchanged between libraries via files (no shared `pxr` memory object
SD 25.11 runtime; models are exchanged between libraries via files (no shared `pxr` memory objects).
